# Little Hanniel

> Little Hanniel is a premium family home bakery in Batam, Indonesia, specializing in freshly made cold-chain overnight oats, artisanal cookies, bakes, and Korean kitchen items ordered via WhatsApp.

## Key Sections

- [Menu & Offerings](https://little.hanniel.co/#menu) — Freshly made overnight oats (Tiramisu, Strawberry, Double Chocolate), cookies (Almond Choco, Double Choco, Raisin Oats), Banana/Carrot loaves, Gimbap rolls, and Japchae.
- [Pricing](https://little.hanniel.co/#menu) — Transparent unit pricing in IDR: Overnight Oats (42k/jar), Artisanal Cookies (70k/pouch), Loaves (38k - 48k), Gimbap (70k - 78k), and Sides (55k).
- [Location & Hours](https://little.hanniel.co/#contact) — Based in Batam, Indonesia. Operates Monday to Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 WIB with cold-chain delivery same-day.
- [Ordering & WhatsApp Contact](https://wa.me/message/OZUDXGIT5FJEE1) — Fast deep link to place orders directly over WhatsApp with personal response within ~1 hour.
- [FAQ](https://little.hanniel.co/#faq) — Customer information covering freshness storage, Batam delivery areas, Halal ingredients, and ordering formats.
- [Family Story Journal](https://little.hanniel.co/#journal) — The narrative of our family business starting in 2024.

## Optional
